subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The rocky terrain made the hike difficult and __strenuous__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"strenuous"** means something that requires or uses great exertion or effort; it is difficult and tiring. (श्रमसाध्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The strenuous workout left everyone exhausted.
 
 
 
• **"Easy" **refers to something that requires little or no effort, is not difficult, and is simple to accomplish. (आसान)
 
 
• **Example: **The task was so easy that even a child could do it.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'strenuous' **is **'easy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Demanding **(मांगलिक): Requiring much skill or effort.

 
 
• **Example:** The job was very demanding, requiring long hours and intense concentration.
 
 
 
• **Lively **(जीवंत): Full of life and energy.
 
 
• **Example: **The lively music got everyone up and dancing.
 
 
 
• **Intense** (तीव्र): Of extreme force, degree, or strength.
 
 
• **Example:** The intense heat made it hard to stay outside for long.
